requirements.description: User prefers properties near public transport. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71).

The user explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >= 180. The capacity of 14 people is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-property-area threshold per occupant was supplied. Turin is a city, so it is handled by the Location Agent and comune_code is not set. Proximity to public transport and the absence of an energy class requirement are not mapped to reference columns.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Attività scolastiche' AND surface_area >= 180 AND mobility >= 71 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on school property type, surface area of at least 180 sqm, mobility score of at least 71, and a 3.0 km haversine radius around the supplied coordinates. Results are ordered by distance from that point. The capacity of 14 and the energy class preference are not in the extracted requirements, so they are not applied.
